scope: Browser/WebGPU tuning and correctness repair; no Pooled comparison or independent full-model qualification.
meanMethod: Arithmetic mean over all valid non-warmup samples; no performance summary for failed runs.

runs.name: s23-prefill-chunk512-screen
runs.scope: Tuning screen only: both engines are Doppler at the same frozen runtime and weights; baseline 256-token versus candidate 512-token prefill chunks. One warmup plus three measured alternating pairs. Hypothesis: larger chunks reduce partially filled expert groups and repeated weight fetches; retain only unchanged outputs and a repeatable improvement. No Pooled claim or numerical promotion.

runs.name: s24-prefill-chunk1024-screen
runs.scope: Tuning screen only: same frozen Doppler source and model in both sessions; 256-token baseline versus 1024-token candidate chunks. Candidate starts first, reversing s23 startup order. One warmup plus three measured alternating pairs; all outputs retained. Hypothesis: larger prefill chunks reduce partial expert groups and repeated weights. No Pooled claim or numerical promotion.

runs.name: s25-static-group-bounds-screen
runs.scope: Tuning only: identical Doppler model, 256-token prefill chunks and runtime except fixed declared group-loop bounds with guards in routed MoE native_f32. Frozen baseline and candidate source roots. Preliminary physical component fixtures preserve exact bits. One warmup plus three measured alternating pairs; all quality tasks and 128-token short/long continuations retained. No common-weight Pooled or release qualification.

runs.name: s26-named-group-accumulators-screen
runs.disposition: not accepted: small difference confounded by resident-session order
runs.scope: Tuning only: identical frozen Doppler model and 256-token prefill chunks. Candidate replaces dynamically indexed private accumulator storage with eight named row vectors; dot and reduction arithmetic retain original order. Candidate starts first, reversing s25. One warmup plus three measured alternating pairs, every output retained. Separate physical component exact-bit checks required before the full-model screen. No Pooled or release claim.
